Abstract excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are now embedded in scientific, educational, and governance workflows, with debates centering on their capabilities, mechanisms, and impacts. Yet these debates remain structured by persistent folk theories--intuitive, informal explanatory models that guide attitudes and actions.
